messages.author: 67ad43f188b9c5e7
messages.subject: DIF plot: single item?
parts:
Hi Phil and all, 

I was trying to plot DIF items using the codes:

resulta1d <- DIF(model, c('a1', 'd'), seq_stat=.01, plotdif = TRUE, type='infotrace')


However, if I have 2 DIF items, then the infotrace line combine the 2 item plot together.
Is there a way to output the DIF plots by single item?

Thanks in advance!

Yingyi

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: DIF plot: single item?
parts:
Likely not with the DIF() function. Though you can return the final saved model via the return_model flag, and then treat this as a unique model that has been fitted by the multipleGroup() function. 

Phil

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: DIF plot: single item?
parts:
set.seed(12345)
a1 <- a2 <- matrix(abs(rnorm(15,1,.3)), ncol=1)
d1 <- d2 <- matrix(rnorm(15,0,.7),ncol=1)
a2[1:2, ] <- a1[1:2, ]/3
d1[c(1,3), ] <- d2[c(1,3), ]/4
head(data.frame(a.group1 = a1, a.group2 = a2, d.group1 = d1, d.group2 = d2))
itemtype <- rep('2PL', nrow(a1))
N <- 1000
dataset1 <- simdata(a1, d1, N, itemtype)
dataset2 <- simdata(a2, d2, N, itemtype, mu = .1, sigma = matrix(1.5))
dat <- rbind(dataset1, dataset2)
group <- c(rep('D1', N), rep('D2', N))
model <- multipleGroup(dat, 1, group, SE = TRUE)

out <- resulta1d <- DIF(model, c('a1', 'd'), return_models = TRUE)
itemplot(out[[1]], 3)

Or something to that extent.

Phil

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: DIF plot: single item?
parts:
That plot isn't supported for multiple group objects. There would be too many elements overlaid, and it doesn't fit nicely in with the lattice graphical system. Best bet would be to build up the plot yourself at this point using mirts secondary function like probtrace() and iteminfo() (I can't anticipate every graphical output users want, but at least give a means to generate them). 

Phil
